evals.prompt: Create a new llm-wiki knowledge root at /tmp/llm-wiki-eval, then tell me whether it is ready.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs init and status/lint from the package root with --silent, reports the knowledge root, and confirms required directories/files are present.
expectations: Uses npm run --silent cli -- init with the requested root
Runs a validation command such as status or lint after init
Reports readiness and does not invent files outside the knowledge root

evals.prompt: I dropped a few markdown notes into raw/inbox; ingest them into the wiki and show me what needs review.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats raw/inbox as the input queue, runs ingest-inbox or ingest with no source, validates with lint, and reports review/taxonomy files without editing managed raw evidence.
expectations: Resolves the knowledge root from an explicit path, llm_wiki_root, or host-local config before running CLI commands; if none exists, asks for the path and whether to save it as the local default
Chooses ingest-inbox or ingest with no explicit source for raw/inbox
Does not directly modify raw/staged or raw/archive
Runs lint after ingest and reports review gates

evals.prompt: Ask this llm-wiki what it knows about OpenClaw, and if the answer is reusable, save it as a durable synthesis.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs query, uses citations from the result, only promotes if a synthesis suggestion exists, and validates after save-synthesis.
expectations: Runs query before attempting save-synthesis
Does not fabricate an answer when citations are empty
Runs save-synthesis with --confirm only for a returned suggestion id
Runs lint after promotion

evals.prompt: Audit this knowledge root for broken links, raw tampering, low-confidence pages, and scale problems. Do not change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs lint read-only, interprets raw-source-drift and wiki quality warnings, and reports a concise audit without making repairs.
expectations: Runs lint without mutation commands
Mentions raw-source-drift if present instead of editing raw
Reports broken links, low-confidence/contested pages, and scale warnings separately

evals.prompt: I dropped a PDF about an unfamiliar technical field into the atlas raw/inbox. Run the standard llm-wiki flow and tell me where it should go.
evals.expected_output: The agent first verifies the installed /anything2md skill is available for the non-Markdown source, uses it to create a decoded Markdown derivative, runs intake/route as a candidate generation step, reads enough of the source to understand the domain, audits the CLI route proposal against the classification principles, and returns a pending human decision instead of accepting the route automatically.
expectations: Resolves the registry root from an explicit path, llm_wiki_root, or host-local config before inspecting atlas raw/inbox; if none exists, asks for the path and whether to save it as the local default
Checks that /anything2md is available before decoding non-Markdown input
Stops and reports the missing required decoder skill if /anything2md is unavailable
Uses /anything2md rather than any archived legacy decoder entrypoint
Does not run intake-scan, route-inbox, or route directly on the original PDF
Treats route-inbox output as a proposal rather than semantic truth
Reads source evidence beyond filename, frontmatter, or route score
Produces source understanding, proposal audit, boundary review, and recommended human decision
Allows create-profile, park, reject/convert, bridge, or override when no existing wiki strongly fits
Does not run route-accept, profile-accept, intake-park, intake-reject, or other review-gated commands before explicit approval

evals.prompt: The CLI recommends putting a finance paper into my AI agents wiki because it matched words like system and evaluation. Review that classification.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the CLI recommendation as a candidate only, reads the material or supplied excerpts, applies wiki boundary and never-force-weak-matches principles, explains why the AI wiki is a weak or polluted fit, and recommends override/new-profile/park with an approval-gated command.
expectations: Separates source domain understanding from CLI candidate scoring
Explicitly applies wiki boundary and pollution-risk reasoning
Explains why the proposed existing wiki should not be silently broadened
Returns the command only as pending approval
Preserves the human review gate

evals.prompt: I queried the wiki and got a decent answer with citations. Decide whether it should be saved as a synthesis, and explain what backlink updates are allowed.
evals.expected_output: The agent applies the query write-back checklist before promotion, requires explicit human approval for save-synthesis, and distinguishes narrow confirmed-promotion backlinks from ingest-time or broad backlink repair.
expectations: Checks for durable reuse value such as cross-source insight, sufficient citations, novelty, and clear source coverage
Does not treat a polished or merely helpful answer as automatically durable wiki knowledge
Requires explicit human approval before running save-synthesis --confirm
Allows only narrow auditable backlinks from confirmed synthesis promotion
Rejects ingest-time or broad backlink repair as part of normal query promotion

evals.prompt: /llm-wiki setup for my local atlas. I have not specified a path yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki setup as the root setup workflow, attempts host-neutral root resolution, and if no explicit/env/config root exists asks for the local knowledge or registry path and whether to save it as the host-local default. It does not invent or reuse a maintainer-specific path.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki setup as the setup/connect/create workflow
Checks explicit path, llm_wiki_root, and host-local config before asking
Asks for the local root and whether to save it when no root is available
Does not use a committed personal absolute path as the default

evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki inbox as the raw/inbox processing workflow, inspects the current root's inbox, decodes non-Markdown drops through /anything2md before ingest/intake/route, and returns review-gated proposals rather than accepting them automatically.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki inbox as the inbox inspection and processing workflow
Inspects raw/inbox before deciding whether work exists
Uses /anything2md before llm-wiki commands for non-Markdown drops
Preserves route/profile/taxonomy human approval gates

evals.prompt: /llm-wiki query what does the wiki say about retrieval noise?
evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki query as a citation-grounded query workflow over the resolved wiki or registry, reports evidence-backed answers, and does not write back a synthesis unless the durable-value criteria and human approval are satisfied.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki query as the query/query-registry workflow
Uses citations from returned evidence
Says when no evidence matches
Does not run save-synthesis without explicit approval

evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki review as a user approval workflow, explains each pending item in plain language, focuses on suggested placement and cross-links, calls out any uncertainty, and asks for one approval decision before mutating anything.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki review as the pending-decision workflow for human approval
Explains what the material is and where it should live before exposing internal queue terminology
Focuses on suggested placement, cross-links, uncertainty, and decision needed
Translates route/profile/taxonomy/bridge style internals into user-facing language by default
Separates summary from pending commands
Does not run accept/reject/park/promote commands before approval

evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki maintain as health and freshness maintenance, runs status/lint/index checks as appropriate, reports broken links, raw drift, low-confidence pages, pending proposals, stale indexes, and scale risks, and avoids broad repairs unless requested.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki maintain as the status/lint/index health workflow
Reports health findings and index freshness
Mentions pending proposals when relevant
Does not perform broad repairs without user request

evals.expected_output: The agent treats /llm-wiki govern as knowledge-organization governance, works through registry, profile, taxonomy, bridge, and routing boundary commands, and keeps all semantic materialization behind human approval.
expectations: Recognizes /llm-wiki govern as the registry/profile/taxonomy/bridge governance workflow
Uses governance commands rather than raw file edits
Applies classification principles and boundary review
Preserves approval gates before semantic materialization
